answer.reason: The verses tell of Jehonadab joining Jehu in his chariot and of the command he gave his sons to drink no wine, which they kept.

clauses.english: was taken up into Jehu's chariot to see his zeal for the LORD
clauses.quote: he took him up to him into the chariot

clauses.english: commanded his sons to drink no wine and dwell in tents, and they obeyed
clauses.quote: Jonadab the son of Rechab our father commanded us

doubts: JER 35 spells the name Jonadab; taken as the same man as Jehonadab son of Rechab.
Verse 2KI 10:23 only mentions him going into the house of Baal with Jehu, so it was left out as adding no separate deed.
